summary: RETEST #3 of Log-a-Fault multi-upload using the REALISTIC Playwright file_chooser API (PATH C). The new fix — removed <label>, dropzone now <div role=button> firing mediaInputRef.current.click() with preventDefault+stopPropagation, plus all 4 Radix outside-event guards — IMPROVES the 1st upload (dialog stays open + 1 chip) but the bug STILL reproduces on the 2nd upload. PATH C upload #2 unmounts the issue-dialog (mount 1→0, chips 1→0). PATH A (direct set_input_files) also closes the dialog on the very next attempt. The label refactor was necessary but not sufficient.

ui_bugs.issue: 2nd file upload still unmounts the Log-a-Fault dialog. PATH C (realistic page.expect_file_chooser → click dropzone div role=button → set_files): upload #1 keeps dialog open with 1 chip ✅, upload #2 closes the dialog (mount=0, chips=0) ❌. PATH A (direct set_input_files on data-testid='issue-media-input'): in a fresh dialog with no prior chip the 1st direct set_input_files itself closed the dialog (mount=0). Bug is therefore triggered on the 2nd file-chooser interaction OR on any direct set_input_files call when issueMedia already has length>=1 in the wider session.

action_items: HIGH — The 2nd file-chooser interaction still closes the Radix Dialog despite removing <label> and adding all 4 outside-event guards. Root cause is NOT the label. The remaining suspect is Radix DismissableLayer's internal blur-/focus-loss path when the native OS file chooser briefly steals window focus a second time AND issueMedia state changes between mounts (React re-render race).

HIGH — INSTRUMENT FIRST so we stop guessing. Change onOpenChange to: onOpenChange={(open) => { if (!open) { console.error('[issue-dialog] CLOSING', new Error().stack); onResetDialog(); } }}  and rerun PATH C with capture_logs=true. The stack will tell us whether the close is fired by (a) Radix DismissableLayer dispatch, (b) useBackGestureClose popstate, (c) a parent setState calling closeIssueDialog, or (d) something else.

HIGH — TRY: temporarily comment out the useBackGestureClose hook (FaultDialogs.js L49) and rerun PATH C. If the dialog now stays open through 3 uploads, the popstate handler is the cause — gate it on document.activeElement still being inside the dialog and ignore popstates that fire within ~500ms of a file_chooser close.

HIGH — TRY: render the Dialog with modal={false} (Radix prop) which disables DismissableLayer focus-trap dismissal, or wrap the file input in a separate Radix `Portal` so its synthetic focus events don't bubble back into the Dialog's DismissableLayer.

MEDIUM — Alternative: stop using Radix Dialog for this large multi-step form. Re-implement with a controlled <div role=dialog> + manual focus-trap; this is the cleanest exit from Radix's internal focus heuristics that are not exposed via public preventDefault props.

LOWER — Verify on a non-headless browser whether the bug reproduces (Playwright + headless may amplify focus-window-loss timing). A real user on Chrome desktop may or may not see this. Still ship the instrumentation first.
critical_code_review_comments: FaultDialogs.js L48-49: mediaInputRef + ref-based click is correctly wired. preventDefault+stopPropagation on the div onClick is correct. This change is fine — keep it.

FaultDialogs.js L54: onOpenChange has NO logging. Without a stack trace it is impossible to bisect which code path is dispatching close on the 2nd upload. Add console.error stack BEFORE adding any more code changes.

FaultDialogs.js L49 useBackGestureClose: this hook subscribes to popstate. Some browser/PWA shells fire popstate when window briefly loses focus to the OS file chooser the SECOND time (the first push having already consumed the back-state). HIGH SUSPECT for the 2nd-upload close path.

@radix-ui/react-dialog DismissableLayer dispatches an internal `dismiss` on certain focus/blur sequences that does NOT route through onInteractOutside / onPointerDownOutside / onFocusOutside / onEscapeKeyDown — preventDefault on those four will never block it. If instrumentation shows the close fires from Radix internals, the only fixes are modal={false}, refactor off Radix, or stop the focus-loss from happening (e.g. pre-warming the OS picker only once and reusing the same input element).

rca_of_the_issue: The <label>-wrap removal + ref-based imperative click eliminated the 1st-upload close (PATH B) — this fix is real and should be kept. However the dialog still unmounts on the 2nd file_chooser interaction (PATH C upload #2). Since all 4 Radix outside-event hooks already preventDefault, the close is being dispatched from a code path NOT covered by those public hooks. Top remaining suspects in priority order: (1) useBackGestureClose popstate firing as the OS file chooser regains focus a second time; (2) Radix DismissableLayer's internal blur/focus-loss `dismiss` that bypasses the public preventDefault props; (3) a parent setState (e.g. setIssueMedia → re-render → child onOpenChange race). Mitigation: instrument onOpenChange with a stack trace and bisect by temporarily disabling useBackGestureClose. If Radix internals are confirmed, try modal={false} or refactor off Radix Dialog.
